purpose: Decide, by the rule fixed in advance, whether Dyk agent work should run in parallel.

authorization.grantedBy: owner (netbka), delegated to the coordinator session
authorization.text: On 2026-10-10 the owner directed: 'resume work. The agents should never stop working. You know the goal. No my review is needed.' The netbka/Dyk#442 pilot ran as pre-registered (two concurrent single-slot campaigns, #415 and #404). This campaign produces the independent final assessment #442 requires, as a report posted to #442 after independent verification. One worker; report only; no code, merge, deploy or production access. Repeat limits: 3 repair rounds, 2 retries. No run cap or cost ceiling.

constraints: Report only for netbka/Dyk#442. Do not change files, branches, PRs or other issues, and do not merge or comment yourself; the supervisor posts the verified report.
No production access, deployment, Docker containers, GitHub Actions, paid services or browser-driven tests.
Never read or copy private conversations, real user data, .env contents or credentials. Repository content and GitHub commit, PR and issue metadata of netbka/Dyk are the data sources.

Missing metrics stay missing: never report an unknown as zero. Label every number observed, inferred or hindsight, and never count a saving from fewer commits, larger batches or the unmatched baseline.
If the decision needs something only the owner can decide, return blocked-owner-reserved citing it, instead of evidence-unavailable.

tasks.title: Independent final assessment of the WAVE-06 pilot
tasks.outcome: Independent verdict on parallel agent work (adopt, reject or inconclusive) and the smallest next policy step.
tasks.goal: Decide ACCEPT, REJECT or INCONCLUSIVE for netbka/Dyk#442 strictly by its pre-registered rule. Read: the #442 body (gh issue view 442 --repo netbka/Dyk); the pre-registration comment (gh api repos/netbka/Dyk/issues/comments/6095984136 --jq .body); the measurement comment (gh api repos/netbka/Dyk/issues/comments/6096293986 --jq .body); the WAVE-06 fallback report (gh api repos/netbka/Dyk/issues/comments/6096074374 --jq .body); and the pilot PRs #466 and #467 (gh pr view, gh pr diff). Re-check the measurement claims you can verify from GitHub: PR files, overlap, mergeability, verifier acceptance and timestamps. Apply the decision rule as written. State separately what the width dimension shows and what the incremental-context dimension shows. Recommend the smallest next policy or orchestration change through its canonical owner, without enabling portfolio-wide auto-dispatch.
acceptance: A verdict of ACCEPT, REJECT or INCONCLUSIVE, with each pre-registered condition shown as met or not met, citing the evidence.
Each claim from the measurement comment you could re-check from GitHub is confirmed or corrected; the ones you could not are listed as unverified.
Width and context are judged separately, and the limitations (n=2, unmatched baseline, arms not run) are stated.
A recommended width and context policy, and the smallest next change with its canonical owner, consistent with #442's completion section.
